name: Roasted Spaghetti Squash with Pork Sausage Ragù & Parmesan

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 260°C (500°F) and place racks in the upper and center positions. Line two baking sheet pans with aluminum foil to make cleanup easier (optional).
Wash and dry each squash; trim, halve lengthwise, and scrape out the seeds. Rub the inside of the squash with oil and season with salt and pepper. Arrange halves, cut-side down, on the baking sheets.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 medium spaghetti squash
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place squash in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until tender, so a knife can easily pierce through the flesh, 25-30 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash, dry, trim, and small dice celery. Place in a medium bowl.
Peel, halve, and small dice onions; add to the bowl with the celery.
Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add celery, onion, and sausage; cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 6-7 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
0.68 kg ground pork sausage

instructions.primary_message: Add marinara, water, salt, and pepper to the pot; stir to combine the ragù. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until thickened, 6-7 minutes. Remove from heat and cover to keep warm.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ (680 g) jars marinara sauce
¾ cup water
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: When the squash is done, remove from oven and allow to cool slightly, about 5 minutes.
Scrape the inside of the squash with a fork to separate into spaghetti-like strands. (Use an oven mitt or towel to hold it with your other hand.)
To serve, divide squash and ragù between plates or bowls. Top with Parmesan and enjoy!
